summary: BTC ~$80.5k, -0.3% in 24h. Overnight it wicked to ~$79.15k on thin weekend liquidity (about $400m of longs liquidated in four hours) and has recovered above $80.5k. Peter Schiff calls a breakdown toward $75k, while others read retail bearishness as a contrarian signal; traders are watching $80k/$76k support into the Fed meeting. Electrum disclosed and patched (v4.8.3) a wallet flaw used in at least one theft, a user-security issue rather than a network one. Eased from -0.10 to -0.05 on the recovery.
